text:
Zara (People Ops): Heads up 1 urgent exception: candidate Raj Patel (senior infra mgr, external) requesting cross-border start 2026-10-15 with dependent visa timing. Hiring requests provisional L8 uplift + prepaid partial sign-on and benefits day-one or bridging for dependents. Packet: https://redwood-internal/hr/offers/raj-patel
Theo (Hiring Manager): Raj will run the compute stack initiative. We need him onboard by 10/15 or we lose roadmap momentum. Proposed provisional base $310k -> $340k, sign-on $60k (30% at start, 70% at 6mo), dependent bridging stipend $1,200/mo for up to 3 months.
Mei (Recruiter): candidate verbal accept pending final offer and visa clause. He requests explicit dependent coverage start since family relocation timeline is fixed.
Carlos (Finance): need GL and confirmed uplift delta. >$25k uplift needs exec comp signoff. Also note prepaid sign-on timing affects cashflow; provide schedule.
Zara (People Ops): numbers here:
```
Current band: L8 baseline $310,000
Proposed provisional: $340,000 (+$30k)
Sign-on: $60,000 (30% at start = $18k, remainder at 6 months = $42k)
Dependent bridging stipend: $1,200/mo up to 3 months (max $3,600)
Benefits requested: 2026-10-15 effective for employee and dependents
Rationale: critical program lead; high risk of candidate withdrawing without dependent coverage
```
CompLead (Comp Committee): please attach peer comp sheet and manager statement. We'll do a fast-track but need VP approval for >$25k uplift.
Legal (Legal): recommend visa and dependent guarantee clause and a 12-month clawback on sign-on. Also add tax advisory note for dependent stipend. Template uploaded.
Carlos (Finance): GL: 6101.9000, budget owner: eng-core. Finance can provision contingent on VP signoff and Legal text.
Theo (Hiring Manager): VP Eng verbal ok in DM pending comp committee confirmation.
CompLead (Comp Committee): approved (fast-track) contingent on VP Eng signoff. Added note: provisional for 90 days with performance milestones.
Zara (People Ops): routing summary: comp-committee -> finance -> legal -> VP Eng final. Target to send offer today EOD 16:00 PT. Mei to include dependent stipend clause and repayment terms.
Mei (Recruiter): will send draft at 15:45 PT. Candidate ok with 30/70 sign-on split and 90-day provisional review.
hr-bot: scheduled reminder: "90-day review for Raj Patel provisional uplift" on 2027-01-13.
